---
title: "Quarto Playground"
format:
  html:
    html-math-method: mathjax
    include-in-header:
      text: |
        <script>
        window.MathJax = {
          loader: {
            load: ['[custom]/siunitx.js', '[tex]/html', '[tex]/gensymb'],
            paths: { custom: './assets/' }
          },
          tex: {
            packages: { '[+]': ['siunitx', 'html', 'gensymb'] },
            siunitx: {
              'per-mode': 'power'
            }
          }
        };
        </script>
